When the adapter reports stopping, the job raises `Continuation::Interrupt` at the next checkpoint, `around_perform :continue` catches it and calls `retry_job` with `resume_options` (default `wait: 5.seconds`), and the serialized continuation (current step and cursor) travels with the job so the next run resumes from it.
